library.title: Games Library
library.subtitle: Manage and sync your game saves in the cloud

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account, cloud, app, gamepads, and integrations

language.title: App Language
language.subtitle: Select the interface language for SaveCloud

autostart.title: Start with Windows
autostart.subtitle: Launch the app automatically when logging in, so your saves are synced in the background.

bigPicture.title: Big Picture Mode
bigPicture.subtitle: Start in full screen console-like mode
bigPicture.desc: Opens a dedicated Big Picture window and hides the main window in the tray while active.
bigPicture.helpText: You can return to normal mode from the button below or with Escape inside the Big Picture window.
bigPicture.label: When starting Savecloud

gameMode.title: Game Mode
gameMode.subtitle: Reduces contention with your games: less network and disk usage by SaveCloud, and a more favorable energy profile if supported. Does not replace GPU drivers or guarantee higher FPS on corporate or restricted systems.
gameMode.pauseTrafficDesc: Pauses active multipart uploads (if any), ongoing SaveCloud torrents, and downloads from sources with Running status until exiting the mode.
gameMode.powerProfileWin: Activates the Windows «High performance» power plan with powercfg (if supported by system).
gameMode.powerProfileOther: On macOS it can use caffeinate if available. On some Linux desktops it attempts «powerprofilesctl set performance» (must be in PATH).
gameMode.gameBar: Reduce Xbox Game DVR overhead (Windows only)
gameMode.gameBarDesc: Optional: adjusts AppCaptureEnabled under HKCU to reduce recording/background related to Game Bar. Reverted when game mode is disabled.
gameMode.cpuPriorityDesc: After a few seconds (~process monitor interval), only if the game's executable name (.exe) matches what is configured for it in the library — for example re9.exe. If it does not match, SaveCloud will not touch the process. On Windows, logs will show «[CpuBoost] Elevated priority…» or a warning if access was denied. Independent of the «Game Mode» switch.

performance.title: Low performance mode
performance.subtitle: Disables interface transitions, blur visual effects, automatic videos in catalog/profiles, and interactive WebGL components. Recommended for integrated GPUs, laptops on battery, or legacy PCs.

gpuAcceleration.title: Disable hardware acceleration
gpuAcceleration.subtitle: Disables GPU usage for rendering the interface. Can solve flickering, black screen issues, or graphics driver incompatibility.
gpuAcceleration.warning: * Requires restarting the application to apply changes.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.desc: Saved in the active profile. In the installed app, it unlocks the webview inspector (DevTools), shortcuts like F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I, and the context menu; it also displays plugin tools (Lua SDK, logs).
developer.viteInfo: In vite, the inspector is usually already available; the switch mostly affects production builds and the settings saved in the profile.
developer.lockedInfo: Enable developer mode above to use DevTools in production.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: If the app is not visible (minimized or behind another window), a notification will be shown when an upload, download, or full backup completes, or if an error occurs. Use the button to check permissions.

proxy.title: Proxy Server (HTTP/SOCKS5)
proxy.desc: Routes downloads from hosters (like Gofile or Pixeldrain) and requests to third-party APIs through a proxy to avoid IP limitations or temporary blocks.
proxy.label: Proxy address
proxy.helpText: Supported schemes: http://, https://, socks5://, socks5h:// (local/remote SOCKS5 DNS). Leave blank to disable.

releaseNotes.title: Release notes
releaseNotes.subtitle: View up to 10 recent versions from GitHub. If there is no connection, you will see the local version.

updatesCard.title: Updates
updatesCard.subtitle: Check if there is a new version of the app. If it exists, you will be offered to download and install it.

sourceInstall.title: Installation from Sources
sourceInstall.subtitle: Import JSON catalogs (by URL or file) and configure the destination folder for downloads.
sourceInstall.importJsonHelp: Import a source JSON to view your catalogs here.
sourceInstall.autoExtractHelp: Automatically decompress archive files upon completion of the download (ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, etc.). If disabled, the downloaded archive will be kept without extraction.

gamepadTester.title: Your Controller
gamepadTester.desktopOnlyDesc: This test is only available in the Savecloud desktop app.
gamepadTester.mainDesc: Connect the controller via cable or its wireless adapter. With Savecloud or the Settings window in focus, you will see how sticks and buttons respond. The vibration button sends a small pulse if supported by the system (vibration is not available on some Macs).
gamepadTester.navDesc: You can also use the controller to navigate the app (navigation, confirm, and back).
gamepadTester.noGamepadFound: No controller detected. Plug one in and click 'Search again'.
gamepadTester.detectionInfo: Detected as '{{name}}': the automatic profile is {{profile}}. You can set another layout below for the diagram and labels.
gamepadTester.selectLabel: Which controller would you like to inspect?
gamepadTester.noButtonsPressed: None pressed. Try the D-pad or face buttons.
gamepadTester.telemetryHelp: Press something on your controller: with the Savecloud or Settings window active, clear numbers and names should appear above.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: Import from link or view profile by user
friends.descPlain: Use Import by link if you were sent a share link, or Search by user to load the profile of a trusted friend.

profileCard.desc: Search friends by entering their identifier (e.g., "username"). If a friend gives you theirs, type it here to view their games, copy saves to your cloud, or use templates.
profileCard.label: Friend's username

gamesSection.noGames: This friend has no games configured in their settings.

invitesTab.title: Share Cloud / Links
invitesTab.subtitle: Share a link so your friend can access the host's cloud (no manual setup required).
invitesTab.inviteeInputHelp: If left blank, you generate a link with a code (token) for anyone who receives it.
invitesTab.inviteTokenHelp: Give this to your friend: they can paste it here to accept (no setup required).
invitesTab.tokenInputPlaceholder: Paste the full link or code
invitesTab.tokenInputHelp: If you paste a link (recommended), the app automatically discovers the server URL.
invitesTab.refreshHelp: Updates automatically while this tab is open.
invitesTab.activeCloudHelp: Select which cloud to use to sync your saves.
invitesTab.cloudsAsMember: Clouds where you are a member
invitesTab.noSharedClouds: You do not belong to any shared cloud.
invitesTab.membersInCloudHelp: Users who have access to your cloud as members.
invitesTab.noMembersActive: You have no active members in your cloud.

templateModal.title: Use friend's configuration as template
templateModal.desc: Create a game in your settings by copying your friend's game metadata. You only need to adjust the local path where your saves are located.
templateModal.errorMissingDesc: You need to specify at least the identifier and a local path.

copyConfirm.title: Copy saves from friend to your cloud
copyConfirm.desc: The saves of the game {{name}} will be copied from your friend's cloud to your cloud. The files will be associated with this game in your account.
copyConfirm.conflictWarning_one: 1 file already exists in your cloud and will be copied with a different name (e.g., file (friend 1).sav) to prevent overwriting.
copyConfirm.conflictWarning_other: {{count}} files already exist in your cloud and will be copied with a different name (e.g., file (friend 1).sav) to prevent overwriting.

addGamesModal.desc: Only games you do not already have will be added. Your API key and username will not be changed. Review paths in Settings afterwards.
addGamesModal.noNewGames: No new games to add; you already have all the games from this profile.
addGamesModal.toastNoneSelectedDesc: Select at least one game to add.
addGamesModal.toastSuccessDesc_one: 1 game was added to your configuration. Review paths in Settings if necessary.
addGamesModal.toastSuccessDesc_other: {{count}} games were added to your configuration. Review paths in Settings if necessary.

removeMember.title: Remove member from your cloud
removeMember.body: This user will lose access to your shared cloud and will no longer see their synced saves there.

leaveMembership.title: Leave cloud
leaveMembership.body: You are leaving this shared cloud and will no longer have access to the saves associated with it.

shareLinkImport.title: Import saves from link
shareLinkImport.descWithFiles: The following files for the game {{name}} will be copied to your cloud. If you do not have this game in your list, an entry will be added so you can configure your local path later.
shareLinkImport.descNoFiles: There are no save files in this link for {{name}}. You can still import it to add the game to your list and configure your local path later.
shareLinkImport.gameAddedOnly: The game will be added to your settings without copying any files.

bigPictureHeader.desc: Import saves, search friends, and cloud invitations

bigPictureSearch.title: Search profile by username
bigPictureSearch.desc: Type your friend's username to view their games, copy saves, or add games to your list.

remotePlay.title: Remote Play (LAN)
remotePlay.subtitle: Stream your games or join sessions on your local network
remotePlay.joinSubtitle: Search active hosts on your LAN network

steamCatalog.title: Steam Catalog
steamCatalog.noGamesListed: No games listed yet. Go to Settings, check your Steam key and click 'Sync catalog now'.
steamCatalog.noFilterResults: No games match these filters. Try removing some or combine with a name search.

filters.title: Filters
filters.onlyAffects: Only affects games with downloaded details (genres and tags from the Steam store).
filters.noDataYet: No filter data yet. Sync the catalog and open some game cards to populate genres and tags.

trending.label: Trending
trending.errorLoading: Could not load the featured section.
recommendationVariants: selected by tag matches within the catalog.
highlighted for its affinity with similar genres and tags.
suggested by thematic similarity within the current catalog.
chosen by category and gameplay style relationship.
proposed by tag patterns in related games.

freshness.upToDate: Your local catalog is up to date with the cloud worker data.
freshness.stale: New data is available in the cloud. Click 'Download detailed info' in Settings to update.
freshness.noLocalImport: You haven't downloaded the detailed info from the cloud yet. Do it from Settings with 'Download detailed info'.
freshness.noCloudBatches: No enriched data batches in the cloud yet (the worker hasn't written batches or there is no manifest).
freshness.unknown: Could not check the status (no connection, session, or service unavailable).
